name: microsoft-365
description: Microsoft 365 integration — Outlook mail/calendar, contacts, OneDrive and (org mode) Teams/SharePoint via ms-365-mcp-server.

auth.label: Microsoft Entra ID (OAuth)
auth.hint: The M365 server performs its own interactive MSAL login (a browser window it opens itself). All fields are optional: it falls back to a built-in Microsoft public client and the 'common' (any Microsoft account) tenant when left blank -- only set these if you need your own Azure app registration.

fields.name: MS365_MCP_CLIENT_ID
fields.label: Azure App Client ID
fields.hint: Optional — leave blank to use the server's built-in Microsoft public client.

fields.name: MS365_MCP_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.label: Azure App Client Secret
fields.hint: Only needed for a confidential (secret-bearing) Azure app; the default public client needs none.

fields.name: MS365_MCP_TENANT_ID
fields.label: Azure Tenant ID
fields.hint: Optional — leave blank to use 'common' (works with any Microsoft personal or work account).
